plate.title: B11 · Counterturned interior gardens
plate.description: Each actual pointed chamber supplies its own finite interior placement read and source port. Wide opposed sprays or a radial blossom occupy the interior. Smaller nested leaves and veins articulate those masses, while alternate chamber families take different colours.

constructionNotes: Each actual pointed chamber supplies its own finite interior placement read and source port. Wide opposed sprays or a radial blossom occupy the interior. Smaller nested leaves and veins articulate those masses, while alternate chamber families take different colours. Curved rendering rounds selected flowing contours only; pointed tips, roots and native source seam identities remain fixed. Four colour groups are exact disjoint path selections, not screen-location bins.
